name: Bond Derivative 2
definition: Transparency calculation specific details on a bond derivative.

Issuer.name: Issuer
Issuer.definition: Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) code of the issuer of the direct or ultimate underlying bond.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Date of maturity of the underlying bond. This field applies to debt instruments with defined maturity.

IssuanceDate.name: Issuance Date
IssuanceDate.definition: Populated with the issuance date of the underlying bond.
